title: Independent semantic and composition check — Vegetable L1 ordinary prose candidates
reviewMode: read-only; English-source blind backcheck; no native-speaker/fluent approval claimed
compositionFinding: Tshivenda body.paragraphs.12 candidate does not explicitly preserve the source comparative “do better” in the translated clause and has an uncertain hybrid subject/verb construction. Bounded fallback uses the exact English source sentence and preserves the existing localized second sentence. The comparative remains explicit in the direct-sowing candidate sentences and in the drain-better distractors; those are not held merely for retaining English. For the VE and TS all-conditions false distractors, suggested bounded repairs retain the exact English phrase “Narrow beds drain better” and use the candidate’s locally drafted all-conditions tail because bed-class concord is uncertain. The VE best-suited quiz question gets localized ordinary question framing with the exact English comparative/technical tail. Additional source-bound repairs: ST body paragraph 8 removes the candidate-added “from the bed”; VE key point 1 preserves “Assess” because the candidate verb may mean only look/observe; VE quiz question 0 preserves the current target’s exact English “wider” anchor because the localized candidate may say merely expanded.
limitations: No new farming recommendation, number, crop name, or source claim is proposed.
Blind English backtranslations indicate source meaning; language uncertainties are listed on the affected fields.
